name: Staff of Size Alteration
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 495
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 495
Aura moderate transmutation CL 8th
Slot none; Price 26,150 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This staff of dark wood is stouter and sturdier than most magical staves, with a gnarled and twisted knot of wood at the top end. It allows use of the following spells:
Enlarge person (1 charge)
Reduce person (1 charge)
Shrink item (2 charges)
Mass enlarge person (3 charges)
Mass reduce person (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, enlarge person, mass enlarge person, mass reduce person, reduce person, shrink item; Cost 13,075 gp
